hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A 1:1 ETH/phiEth swap hook implementing a custom constant-price curve. In beforeSwap, it takes the input token from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit or phiEth.withdraw to convert, then settles the output — returning a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity entirely. Direct liquidity addition is permanently blocked.
